clips.tags: Dark fantasy game trailer score, 80 BPM, one-minute cinematic instrumental. Open with a single resonant tolling bell followed by a clear pocket of silence; bring in measured ritual taiko and deep frame drums, building in weight and pace without losing the 80 BPM pulse. Layer an ominous low male choir in wordless chant, eerie arcane high synth shimmer, and restrained sub-bass. At 45 seconds deliver a sudden hard orchestral impact and drop into a stark, spacious final passage; close on one solemn bell toll with a long natural decay. Wide cinematic mix, deep low end, crisp transient impacts, deliberate dynamics.
clips.title: Solemn Bell Toll
